chain.name: Check Aggregate Staleness
chain.sql: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DATEDIFF(HOUR, w.WatermarkValue, GETDATE())), 0) AS StalenessHours FROM etl.Watermark AS w WHERE w.ObjectName LIKE N'Aggregate.%';

chain.name: Build Publication Statements
chain.sql: DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max) = N''; SELECT @sql = @sql + N'TRUNCATE TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(c.TargetSchemaName) + N'.'      + QUOTENAME(c.TargetObjectName) + N'; INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(c.TargetSchemaName)      + N'.' + QUOTENAME(c.TargetObjectName) + N' SELECT * FROM '      + QUOTENAME(c.SourceSchemaName) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(c.SourceObjectName) + N'; ' FROM [Integration].[ReportingPublication] AS c WHERE c.PublicationGroupCode = ? AND c.IsEnabled = 1 ORDER BY c.PublishSequence; EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

chain.name: Rebuild Reporting Indexes
chain.sql: DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max) = N''; SELECT @sql = @sql + N'ALTER INDEX ALL ON ' + QUOTENAME(s.name) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(t.name)      + N' REBUILD; ' FROM sys.tables AS t INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE s.name = N'Report'; EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

chain.name: Stamp Publication Metadata
chain.sql: UPDATE [Integration].[ReportingPublication] SET LastPublishedAt = GETDATE(), LastPublishedByExecutionId = ? WHERE PublicationGroupCode = ? AND IsEnabled = 1;

chain.name: Quarantine Stale Publications
chain.sql: INSERT INTO err.RejectedConstraintViolation     (ObjectName, BusinessKey, RejectReason, RejectedAt, PackageExecutionId) SELECT w.ObjectName, w.ObjectName, N'Aggregate is stale at publication time', GETDATE(), ? FROM etl.Watermark AS w WHERE w.ObjectName LIKE N'Aggregate.%'   AND DATEDIFF(HOUR, w.WatermarkValue, GETDATE()) > ?;

chain.name: Log Rejected Records
chain.sql: EXEC etl.usp_LogRejectedRecord @PackageExecutionId = ?, @ObjectName = N'Report.*', @RejectReason = N'Aggregate row failed the summary quality gate', @RejectRowCount = ?;

chain.name: Recalculate ABC Classification
chain.sql: WITH ranked AS (  SELECT [Product Performance Key],          SUM([Net Amount]) OVER (PARTITION BY [Accounting Period Code]                                  ORDER BY [Net Amount] DESC                                  ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS RunningNet,          SUM([Net Amount]) OVER (PARTITION BY [Accounting Period Code]) AS PeriodNet   FROM [Aggregate].[Product Performance] WHERE [Accounting Period Code] = ?) chain.name: Resolve Identity Graph
chain.sql:
MERGE work.CustomerIdentityGraph AS target
USING (
    SELECT  a.CustomerId
    ,       MIN(b.CustomerId) AS SurvivingCustomerId
    ,       MAX(CASE
                WHEN a.TaxRegistrationNumber = b.TaxRegistrationNumber THEN 100
                WHEN a.StandardEmail = b.StandardEmail                 THEN 95
                WHEN a.CustomerNameNormalised = b.CustomerNameNormalised
                     AND a.StandardPostalCode = b.StandardPostalCode   THEN 88
                ELSE 0 END) AS MatchScore
    FROM    work.CustomerAddressStandardised AS a
    INNER JOIN work.CustomerAddressStandardised AS b
            ON  b.CustomerId <= a.CustomerId
            AND (a.TaxRegistrationNumber = b.TaxRegistrationNumber
                 OR a.StandardEmail = b.StandardEmail
                 OR (a.CustomerNameNormalised = b.CustomerNameNormalised
                     AND a.StandardPostalCode = b.StandardPostalCode))
    GROUP BY a.CustomerId
) AS source
    ON  target.CustomerId = source.CustomerId
WHEN MATCHED AND source.MatchScore >= ? THEN
    UPDATE SET target.SurvivingCustomerId = source.SurvivingCustomerId,
               target.MatchScore = source.MatchScore,
               target.ResolvedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET AND source.MatchScore >= ? THEN
    INSERT (CustomerId, SurvivingCustomerId, MatchScore, ResolvedAtUtc)
    VALUES (source.CustomerId, source.SurvivingCustomerId, source.MatchScore,
            SYSUTCDATETIME());

chain.name: Accrue Points
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.LoyaltyPointLedger
    (CustomerId, RegionCode, AccruedDate, QualifyingAmount, PointsAccrued,
     PointStatusCode, SourceReference)
SELECT  m.CustomerId
,       m.RegionCode
,       m.InvoiceDate
,       CASE m.RegionCode
            WHEN N'NA'   THEN m.GrossAmount
            WHEN N'EU'   THEN m.NetAmount
            WHEN N'APAC' THEN m.GrossAmount - ISNULL(m.GstAmount, 0)
            ELSE m.NetAmount END
,       CASE m.RegionCode
            WHEN N'NA'   THEN FLOOR(m.GrossAmount)
            WHEN N'EU'   THEN FLOOR(m.NetAmount * 1.5)
            WHEN N'APAC' THEN FLOOR((m.GrossAmount - ISNULL(m.GstAmount, 0)) * 2)
            ELSE FLOOR(m.NetAmount) END
,       N'ACTIVE'
,       m.InvoiceNumber
FROM    work.LoyaltyQualifyingSale AS m
WHERE   NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work.LoyaltyPointLedger AS l
                    WHERE l.SourceReference = m.InvoiceNumber);

chain.name: Recalculate Tier Ladders
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.LoyaltyOverlay
    (CustomerId, RegionCode, ActivePoints, ExpiredPoints, PreviousTierCode, TierCode)
SELECT  l.CustomerId
,       l.RegionCode
,       SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE' THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'EXPIRED' THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END)
,       MAX(ISNULL(cur.TierCode, N'NONE'))
,       CASE l.RegionCode
            WHEN N'NA' THEN
                CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 50000 THEN N'PLATINUM'
                     WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 20000 THEN N'GOLD'
                     WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 5000  THEN N'SILVER'
                     ELSE N'BASE' END
            WHEN N'EU' THEN
                CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 75000 THEN N'PREMIER'
                     WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 30000 THEN N'PLUS'
                     ELSE N'STANDARD' END
            ELSE
                CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 40000 THEN N'DIAMOND'
                     WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.PointStatusCode = N'ACTIVE'
                                   THEN l.PointsAccrued ELSE 0 END) >= 15000 THEN N'JADE'
                     ELSE N'MEMBER' END
        END
FROM    work.LoyaltyPointLedger AS l
LEFT OUTER JOIN work.LoyaltyOverlayCurrent AS cur ON cur.CustomerId = l.CustomerId
GROUP BY l.CustomerId, l.RegionCode;

SET    m.[Recency Decile] = d.RecencyDecile
,      m.[Frequency Decile] = d.FrequencyDecile
,      m.[Monetary Decile] = d.MonetaryDecile
FROM   Customer360.CustomerRollingMetric AS m
INNER JOIN (SELECT [Customer Key],

                                   ORDER BY [Days Since Last Order] DESC) AS RecencyDecile,
                   NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY [Region Code]
                                   ORDER BY [Order Count]) AS FrequencyDecile,

chain.name: Assign Segments
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.CustomerSegment
    (CustomerId, RegionCode, SegmentCode, SegmentModelVersion, IsSuppressed, AssignedAtUtc)
SELECT  p.[WWI Customer ID]
,       p.[Region Code]
,       CASE
            WHEN p.[Region Code] = N'EU' AND ISNULL(p.[Is Contactable], 0) = 0
                THEN N'SUPPRESSED'
            WHEN ch.[Churn Risk Band Code] = N'HIGH' AND m.[Monetary Decile] >= 8
                THEN N'AT_RISK_HIGH_VALUE'
            WHEN ch.[Churn Risk Band Code] = N'HIGH'
                THEN N'AT_RISK'
            WHEN m.[Monetary Decile] >= 9 AND m.[Frequency Decile] >= 8
                THEN N'CHAMPION'
            WHEN m.[Recency Decile] >= 8 AND m.[Frequency Decile] <= 3
                THEN N'NEW_PROMISING'
            WHEN lo.[Tier Code] IN (N'PLATINUM', N'PREMIER', N'DIAMOND')
                THEN N'LOYAL_PREMIUM'
            WHEN m.[Activity Status Code] = N'INACTIVE'
                THEN N'DORMANT'
            ELSE N'CORE'
        END
,       ?
,       CASE WHEN p.[Region Code] = N'EU' AND ISNULL(p.[Is Contactable], 0) = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM    Customer360.CustomerProfile AS p
LEFT OUTER JOIN Customer360.CustomerRollingMetric AS m
        ON m.[Customer Key] = p.[Customer Key]
LEFT OUTER JOIN Customer360.CustomerChurnFlag AS ch
        ON ch.[Customer Key] = p.[Customer Key]
LEFT OUTER JOIN Customer360.LoyaltyOverlay AS lo
        ON lo.[WWI Customer ID] = p.[WWI Customer ID];

chain.name: Rebuild Reporting Depth
chain.sql: WITH chain AS ( SELECT [Employee Key], [Manager Key], 1 AS Depth FROM [Dimension].[Employee]   WHERE [Manager Key] IN (-1, 0) AND [Is Current Row] = 1  UNION ALL  SELECT e.[Employee Key], e.[Manager Key], chain.Depth + 1  FROM [Dimension].[Employee] AS e  INNER JOIN chain ON chain.[Employee Key] = e.[Manager Key]  WHERE e.[Is Current Row] = 1) UPDATE e SET e.[Reporting Depth] = chain.Depth FROM [Dimension].[Employee] AS e INNER JOIN chain ON chain.[Employee Key] = e.[Employee Key] OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32);

chain.name: Classify Failure
chain.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ? IN (1205, 1222, 10054, 10060, 12154, 12541, 64, 121)             THEN N'TRANSIENT' ELSE N'PERMANENT' END AS FailureClass,        CASE WHEN ? IN (1205, 1222, 10054, 10060, 12154, 12541, 64, 121)             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RetryableFlag;

chain.name: Close Failed Batch Step
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.BatchStep SET    StepStatus = N'Failed', EndedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME(),        IsRetryable = ?, ErrorMessage = ? WHERE  BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Running' AND PackageName = ?;

chain.name: Close Package Execution
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.PackageExecution SET    ExecutionStatus = N'Failed', EndedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE  BatchId = ? AND PackageName = ? AND ExecutionStatus = N'Running';

chain.name: Mark Batch Retryable
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.Batch SET BatchStatus = N'RetryPending' WHERE BatchId = ? AND BatchStatus = N'Running';

chain.name: Assess Batch Outcome
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS FailedSteps,        CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN s.Criticality = N'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0             THEN N'CRITICAL'             WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN N'WARNING' ELSE N'INFO' END AS Severity FROM   etl.BatchStep AS s WHERE  s.BatchId = ? AND s.StepStatus = N'Failed';

chain.name: Raise Operator Notification
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO etl.OperatorNotification
    (BatchId, NotificationTypeCode, Severity, Subject, Body, RaisedAtUtc, IsAcknowledged)
SELECT  b.BatchId
,       N'BATCH_FAILURE'
,       ?
,       CONCAT(N'[', ?, N'] Batch ', CAST(b.BatchId AS nvarchar(20)),
                N' (', b.BatchType, N') failed')
,       CONCAT(N'Failed steps: ',
                STUFF((SELECT N', ' + s.StepName
                       FROM   etl.BatchStep AS s
                       WHERE  s.BatchId = b.BatchId AND s.StepStatus = N'Failed'
                       FOR XML PATH(N''), TYPE).value(N'.', N'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, N''),
                N'. Last error: ',
                ISNULL((SELECT TOP (1) e.ErrorDescription FROM etl.ErrorLog AS e
                        WHERE e.BatchId = b.BatchId ORDER BY e.LoggedAtUtc DESC),
                       N'none recorded'))
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
,       0
FROM    etl.Batch AS b
WHERE   b.BatchId = ?
AND     NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etl.OperatorNotification AS n
                    WHERE n.BatchId = b.BatchId
                      AND n.NotificationTypeCode = N'BATCH_FAILURE');

chain.name: Raise Warning Notification
chain.sql: INSERT INTO etl.OperatorNotification     (BatchId, NotificationTypeCode, Severity, Subject, Body, RaisedAtUtc, IsAcknowledged) SELECT ?, N'BATCH_WARNING', N'WARNING',        N'Batch completed with rejected rows',        CONCAT(N'Rejected rows in this batch: ', CAST(COUNT(*) AS nvarchar(20))),        SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 FROM   etl.RejectedRecord WHERE BatchId = ? AND IsReprocessed = 0 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

chain.name: Count Notifications
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Notifications FROM etl.OperatorNotification WHERE BatchId = ? AND IsAcknowledged = 0;

chain.name: Gather Bad Files
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.BadFileQueue (FileName, FilePath, QuarantineReasonCode, DetectedAtUtc)
SELECT  f.FileName
,       f.FilePath
,       CASE
            WHEN f.FileSizeBytes = 0                THEN N'ZERO_LENGTH'
            WHEN f.StructuralCheckStatus = N'Failed' THEN N'STRUCTURE'
            WHEN f.FeedCode IS NULL                  THEN N'UNKNOWN_FEED'
            ELSE N'OTHER'
        END
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM    etl.InboundFileRegister AS f
WHERE   f.ProcessingStatus = N'Failed'
AND     f.IsQuarantined = 0;

chain.name: Count Bad Files
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS BadFiles FROM work.BadFileQueue WHERE IsMoved = 0;

chain.name: Register Quarantined File
chain.sql: UPDATE work.BadFileQueue SET IsMoved = 1, MovedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE FilePath = ?;

chain.name: Mark Register Quarantined
chain.sql: UPDATE r SET r.IsQuarantined = 1, r.QuarantinedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM etl.InboundFileRegister AS r INNER JOIN work.BadFileQueue AS q ON q.FilePath = r.FilePath AND q.IsMoved = 1;

chain.name: Notify Quarantine
chain.sql: INSERT INTO etl.OperatorNotification     (BatchId, NotificationTypeCode, Severity, Subject, Body, RaisedAtUtc, IsAcknowledged) SELECT ?, N'FILE_QUARANTINE', N'WARNING', N'Inbound files quarantined',        CONCAT(N'Files moved to quarantine: ', CAST(COUNT(*) AS nvarchar(20))),        SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 FROM   work.BadFileQueue WHERE IsMoved = 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

chain.name: Build Reconciliation Set
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.RowCountReconciliation
    (BatchId, ObjectName, SourceRowCount, StagingRowCount, TargetRowCount,
     RejectedRowCount, TolerancePercent, ExplanationCode)
SELECT  a.BatchId
,       a.ObjectName
,       MAX(CASE WHEN a.CountStage = N'Source'  THEN a.RowCount_ ELSE 0 END)
,       MAX(CASE WHEN a.CountStage = N'Staging' THEN a.RowCount_ ELSE 0 END)
,       MAX(CASE WHEN a.CountStage = N'Target'  THEN a.RowCount_ ELSE 0 END)
,       ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM etl.RejectedRecord AS r
                WHERE r.BatchId = a.BatchId AND r.ObjectName = a.ObjectName), 0)
,       ISNULL(t.TolerancePercent, ?)
,       t.ExplanationCode
FROM    etl.RowCountAudit AS a
LEFT OUTER JOIN etl.RowCountTolerance AS t ON t.ObjectName = a.ObjectName
WHERE   a.BatchId = ?
GROUP BY a.BatchId, a.ObjectName, t.TolerancePercent, t.ExplanationCode;

components.name: work RowCountReconciliation
components.sql_or_table: SELECT BatchId, ObjectName, SourceRowCount, StagingRowCount, TargetRowCount, RejectedRowCount, TolerancePercent, ExplanationCode FROM work.RowCountReconciliation;

chain.name: Evaluate Reconciliation
Measure Reconciliation Outcome
chain.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work.RowCountFailure) AS FailedObjects,        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM etl.ReconciliationResult         WHERE BatchId = ? AND VarianceStatus = N'TOLERATED') AS ToleratedObjects;

chain.name: Find Retryable Steps
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RetryableSteps FROM etl.BatchStep WHERE BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Failed' AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) < ?;

chain.name: Wait Backoff (Retry Sweep)
chain.sql: DECLARE @Delay char(8) = CONVERT(char(8), DATEADD(SECOND, ?, CAST('00:00:00' AS time)), 108); WAITFOR DELAY @Delay;

chain.name: Reset Steps For Retry (Retry Sweep)
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.BatchStep SET    StepStatus = N'Pending', AttemptNumber = ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) + 1,        EndedAtUtc = NULL WHERE  BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Failed' AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1 AND    ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) < ?;

chain.name: Request Step Rerun (Retry Sweep)
chain.sql: INSERT INTO etl.BatchStepRerunRequest     (BatchId, BatchStepId, PackageName, AttemptNumber, RequestedAtUtc, RequestStatus) SELECT BatchId, BatchStepId, PackageName, AttemptNumber, SYSUTCDATETIME(),        N'Requested' FROM   etl.BatchStep WHERE  BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Pending' AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1;

chain.name: Recheck Retryable Steps (Retry Sweep)
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RetryableSteps FROM etl.BatchStep WHERE BatchId = ? AND StepStatus IN (N'Failed', N'Pending') AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) < ?;

chain.name: Wait Backoff (Retry Sweep Final)
chain.sql: DECLARE @Delay char(8) = CONVERT(char(8), DATEADD(SECOND, ?, CAST('00:00:00' AS time)), 108); WAITFOR DELAY @Delay;

chain.name: Reset Steps For Retry (Retry Sweep Final)
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.BatchStep SET    StepStatus = N'Pending', AttemptNumber = ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) + 1,        EndedAtUtc = NULL WHERE  BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Failed' AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1 AND    ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) < ?;

chain.name: Request Step Rerun (Retry Sweep Final)
chain.sql: INSERT INTO etl.BatchStepRerunRequest     (BatchId, BatchStepId, PackageName, AttemptNumber, RequestedAtUtc, RequestStatus) SELECT BatchId, BatchStepId, PackageName, AttemptNumber, SYSUTCDATETIME(),        N'Requested' FROM   etl.BatchStep WHERE  BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Pending' AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1;

chain.name: Recheck Retryable Steps (Retry Sweep Final)
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RetryableSteps FROM etl.BatchStep WHERE BatchId = ? AND StepStatus IN (N'Failed', N'Pending') AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) < ?;

chain.name: Record Retry Attempt
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.BatchStep SET AttemptNumber = ? WHERE BatchId = ? AND StepStatus IN (N'Failed', N'Pending') AND ISNULL(IsRetryable, 0) = 1;

chain.name: Mark Retries Exhausted
chain.sql: UPDATE etl.BatchStep SET    StepStatus = N'Failed', IsRetryable = 0,        ErrorMessage = CONCAT(ISNULL(ErrorMessage, N''), N' | retry limit reached') WHERE  BatchId = ? AND ISNULL(AttemptNumber, 1) >= ? AND    StepStatus IN (N'Failed', N'Pending');

chain.name: Count Still Failing Steps
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS StillFailing FROM etl.BatchStep WHERE BatchId = ? AND StepStatus = N'Failed';

chain.name: Gather Unrouted Rejects
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.RejectRoutingSet
    (RejectedRecordId, BatchId, ObjectName, RejectStage, RejectReasonCode,
     RejectReasonDescription, SourceKey, RejectedAtUtc, AgeDays)
SELECT  r.RejectedRecordId
,       r.BatchId
,       r.ObjectName
,       r.RejectStage
,       r.RejectReasonCode
,       r.RejectReason
,       r.BusinessKey
,       r.LoggedAtUtc
,       DATEDIFF(DAY, r.LoggedAtUtc, SYSUTCDATETIME())
FROM    etl.RejectedRecord AS r
WHERE   r.IsReprocessed = 0
AND     (? = N'ALL' OR r.ObjectName = ?)
AND     NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work.RejectRoutingHistory AS h
                    WHERE h.RejectedRecordId = r.RejectedRecordId);

components.name: ORA V_AP_INVOICE_EXTRACT
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  i.AP_INVOICE_ID,
        i.INVOICE_NBR,
        i.SUPP_ID,
        i.LEGAL_ENTITY_CD,
        i.REGION_CD,
        i.INVOICE_TYPE_CD,
        i.INVOICE_STATUS_CD,
        i.CURRENCY_CD,
        i.INVOICE_AMT,
        WWI_FIN.FN_TAX_AMOUNT(i.AP_INVOICE_ID)  AS TAX_AMT,
        CASE i.REGION_CD
            WHEN 'EU'   THEN i.RECOVERABLE_VAT_AMT
            ELSE 0
        END                                     AS RECOVERABLE_TAX_AMT,
        CASE i.REGION_CD
            WHEN 'EU'   THEN i.NON_RECOVERABLE_VAT_AMT
            WHEN 'NA'   THEN i.SALES_TAX_AMT
            WHEN 'APAC' THEN i.GST_AMT
            ELSE 0
        END                                     AS NON_RECOVERABLE_TAX_AMT,
        CASE i.REGION_CD
            WHEN 'NA'   THEN 'SALESTAX'
            WHEN 'EU'   THEN 'VAT'
            WHEN 'APAC' THEN 'GST'
            ELSE 'NONE'
        END                                     AS TAX_TREATMENT_CD,

        fx.RATE_TYPE_CD,
        fx.RATE,
        CASE WHEN fx.RATE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 / fx.RATE END   AS INVERSE_RATE,
        fx.RATE_SOURCE_CD,
        'GLOBAL'                                            AS REGION_CD,
        fx.LAST_UPDATE_DT

  AND   fx.RATE_DT <  TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND   fx.RATE_TYPE_CD IN ('SPOT', 'CORP', 'AVG')

SELECT  usd_from.RATE_DT,

        usd_from.RATE / NULLIF(usd_to.RATE, 0)              AS RATE,
        usd_to.RATE / NULLIF(usd_from.RATE, 0)              AS INVERSE_RATE,
        'TRIANG'                                            AS RATE_SOURCE_CD,

        usd_from.LAST_UPDATE_DT
FROM    WWI_REF.FX_RATE_DAILY usd_from
        INNER JOIN WWI_REF.FX_RATE_DAILY usd_to

  AND   usd_from.RATE_DT <  TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

        s.LAST_UPDATE_DT
FROM    WWI_MDM.SUPP_MASTER s
        LEFT OUTER JOIN WWI_MDM.V_SUPPLIER_BANK_MASKED b
            ON b.SUPP_ID = s.SUPP_ID
           AND b.PRIMARY_FLG = 'Y'
        LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT SUPP_ID,
                   MAX(QUALITY_CERT_CD) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY CERT_EXPIRY_DT) AS QUALITY_CERT_CD,

  AND   s.LAST_UPDATE_DT <  TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND   (s.LAST_TRANSACTION_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -84) OR s.SUPP_STATUS_CD = 'ACTV')

        m.RegionCode,

        INNER JOIN Loyalty.LoyaltyMembers AS m WITH (NOLOCK)

        INNER JOIN Loyalty.LoyaltyPrograms AS p WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON p.LoyaltyProgramID = m.LoyaltyProgramID

chain.name: Revalue Open Items
chain.sql:
UPDATE p
SET    p.[Revalued Functional Amount] = p.[Transaction Amount] * r.ConversionRate
,      p.[Unrealised Gain Loss Amount] =
           (p.[Transaction Amount] * r.ConversionRate) - p.[Functional Amount]
,      p.[Revaluation Rate Date] = r.RateDate
,      p.[Revaluation Rate Type] = CASE WHEN p.[Account Class] = N'PL' THEN N'AVERAGE' ELSE N'CLOSING' END
FROM   Fact.Payment AS p
INNER JOIN work.FxRevaluationRate AS r
        ON  r.CurrencyCode = p.[Transaction Currency Code]
        AND r.RateTypeCode = CASE WHEN p.[Account Class] = N'PL' THEN N'AVERAGE' ELSE N'CLOSING' END
        AND r.QuoteCurrencyCode = CASE
                WHEN p.[Ledger Code] LIKE N'EU%'   THEN N'EUR'
                WHEN p.[Ledger Code] LIKE N'APAC%' THEN p.[Entity Currency Code]
                ELSE N'USD' END
WHERE  p.[Open Amount] <> 0;

SELECT  ai.ApInvoiceKey
,       ai.SupplierId
,       ai.SupplierSiteCode
,       ai.InvoiceNumber
,       ai.InvoiceDate
,       ai.DueDate
,       ai.CurrencyCode
,       ai.LedgerCode
,       ai.RegionCode
,       ai.InvoiceAmount
,       ai.PaidAmount
,       ai.InvoiceAmount - ai.PaidAmount        AS OpenAmount
,       DATEDIFF(DAY, ai.DueDate, ?)            AS DaysPastDue
        /* Buckets have not changed since the 2004 conversion. The business
           still calls the last one "90+" even though it is really 91 and over. */
,       CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, ai.DueDate, ?) <= 0  THEN 'CURRENT'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, ai.DueDate, ?) <= 30 THEN 'B030'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, ai.DueDate, ?) <= 60 THEN 'B060'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, ai.DueDate, ?) <= 90 THEN 'B090'
            ELSE 'B090P'
        END                                     AS AgingBucketCode
        /* NA books gross of sales tax, EU books net of recoverable VAT and
           APAC books net of GST input credit. Three different rules, three
           different columns, all of them load into the same fact. */
,       CASE ai.RegionCode
            WHEN 'NA'   THEN ai.InvoiceAmount
            WHEN 'EU'   THEN ai.InvoiceAmount - ISNULL(ai.RecoverableVatAmount, 0)
            WHEN 'APAC' THEN ai.InvoiceAmount - ISNULL(ai.GstInputCreditAmount, 0)
            ELSE ai.InvoiceAmount
        END                                     AS ReportableAmount
,       ISNULL(pt.DiscountPercent, 0)           AS EarlyPaymentDiscountPercent
FROM    stg.ApInvoice AS ai
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.PaymentTerms AS pt
        ON  pt.PaymentTermsCode = ai.PaymentTermsCode
WHERE   ai.InvoiceAmount - ai.PaidAmount <> 0
AND     ai.InvoiceStatusCode NOT IN ('CANC', 'VOID', 'DRAFT')
AND     ai.LoadBatchId = ?

components.name: stg ApInvoiceLine
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  l.ApInvoiceLineId
,       l.ApInvoiceKey
,       l.SupplierId
,       l.SupplierTaxRegistrationNumber
,       l.JurisdictionCode
,       l.RegionCode
,       l.LineAmount
,       l.TaxCode
,       l.ServiceCategoryCode
,       ISNULL(t.WithholdingRatePercent, 0)     AS WithholdingRatePercent
,       ISNULL(t.WithholdingThresholdAmount, 0) AS WithholdingThresholdAmount
        /* Three jurisdictions, three completely different rules. NA withholds
           only for 1099-reportable service categories, EU applies the treaty
           rate when the supplier has a registration number, and APAC withholds
           on everything above the local threshold. */
,       CASE
            WHEN l.RegionCode = 'NA'
                 AND l.ServiceCategoryCode IN ('CONS', 'LEGL', 'MEDI', 'RENT')
                THEN l.LineAmount * ISNULL(t.WithholdingRatePercent, 0) / 100
            WHEN l.RegionCode = 'EU'
                 AND NULLIF(l.SupplierTaxRegistrationNumber, '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN l.LineAmount * ISNULL(t.TreatyRatePercent, t.WithholdingRatePercent) / 100
            WHEN l.RegionCode = 'EU'
                THEN l.LineAmount * ISNULL(t.WithholdingRatePercent, 0) / 100
            WHEN l.RegionCode = 'APAC'
                 AND l.LineAmount >= ISNULL(t.WithholdingThresholdAmount, 0)
                THEN l.LineAmount * ISNULL(t.WithholdingRatePercent, 0) / 100
            ELSE 0
        END                                     AS WithholdingAmount
FROM    stg.ApInvoiceLine AS l
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.WithholdingTaxRate AS t
        ON  t.JurisdictionCode = l.JurisdictionCode
        AND t.ServiceCategoryCode = l.ServiceCategoryCode
        AND l.InvoiceDate BETWEEN t.EffectiveFrom AND ISNULL(t.EffectiveTo, '9999-12-31')
WHERE   l.LoadBatchId = ?
AND     l.LineTypeCode <> 'FREIGHT'

chain.name: Build Reconciliation Set
chain.sql:
WITH subledger AS (
    SELECT  p.[Ledger Code]      AS LedgerCode
    ,       p.[Accounting Period] AS AccountingPeriod
    ,       p.[Control Account]  AS AccountCode
    ,       SUM(p.[Functional Amount]) AS SubledgerAmount
    FROM    Fact.Payment AS p
    WHERE   p.[Accounting Period] = ?
    GROUP BY p.[Ledger Code], p.[Accounting Period], p.[Control Account]
), ledger AS (
    SELECT  g.[Ledger Code]      AS LedgerCode
    ,       g.[Accounting Period] AS AccountingPeriod
    ,       g.[Account Code]     AS AccountCode
    ,       SUM(g.[Functional Debit Amount] - g.[Functional Credit Amount]) AS LedgerAmount
    FROM    Fact.[GL Posting] AS g
    WHERE   g.[Accounting Period] = ?
    GROUP BY g.[Ledger Code], g.[Accounting Period], g.[Account Code]
)
INSERT INTO etl.ReconciliationResult
    (BatchId, ReconciliationName, LedgerCode, AccountingPeriod, AccountCode,
     SourceAmount, TargetAmount, VarianceAmount, VarianceStatus, EvaluatedAtUtc)
SELECT  ?
,       N'Subledger to GL'
,       COALESCE(s.LedgerCode, l.LedgerCode)
,       COALESCE(s.AccountingPeriod, l.AccountingPeriod)
,       COALESCE(s.AccountCode, l.AccountCode)
,       ISNULL(s.SubledgerAmount, 0)
,       ISNULL(l.LedgerAmount, 0)
,       ISNULL(s.SubledgerAmount, 0) - ISNULL(l.LedgerAmount, 0)
,       CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(s.SubledgerAmount, 0) - ISNULL(l.LedgerAmount, 0)) <= ?
             THEN N'Within tolerance' ELSE N'Variance' END
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM    subledger AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN ledger AS l
        ON  l.LedgerCode = s.LedgerCode
        AND l.AccountCode = s.AccountCode
        AND l.AccountingPeriod = s.AccountingPeriod;

chain.name: Build Variance Set
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.CycleCountVariance
    (CycleCountId, StockItemId, WarehouseSiteCode, BinLocationCode, CountedQuantity,
     SystemQuantity, VarianceQuantity, VarianceValue, CountedAtUtc, CountStatusCode)
SELECT  cc.CycleCountId
,       cc.StockItemId
,       cc.WarehouseSiteCode
,       cc.BinLocationCode
,       cc.CountedQuantity
,       ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0)
,       cc.CountedQuantity - ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0)
,       (cc.CountedQuantity - ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0)) * ISNULL(si.UnitCost, 0)
,       cc.CountedAtUtc
,       CASE WHEN ABS(cc.CountedQuantity - ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0)) <= ?
              AND ABS((cc.CountedQuantity - ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0))
                      * ISNULL(si.UnitCost, 0)) <= ?
             THEN N'AUTO' ELSE N'HOLD' END
FROM    stg.CycleCount AS cc
LEFT OUTER JOIN work.InventoryPositionDaily AS pos
        ON  pos.StockItemId = cc.StockItemId
        AND pos.WarehouseSiteCode = cc.WarehouseSiteCode
        AND pos.BinLocationCode = cc.BinLocationCode
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.StockItem AS si ON si.StockItemId = cc.StockItemId
WHERE   cc.LoadBatchId = ?
AND     cc.CountedQuantity <> ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0);

chain.name: Measure Variances
chain.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CountStatusCode = N'AUTO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AutoPost,        SUM(CASE WHEN CountStatusCode = N'HOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HeldForRecount FROM work.CycleCountVariance;

components.name: work InventoryPositionDaily
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  p.StockItemId
,       p.WarehouseSiteCode
,       p.BinLocationCode
,       p.SnapshotDate
,       p.QuantityOnHand
,       p.QuantityAllocated
,       p.QuantityOnOrder
,       p.QuantityInTransit
,       p.QuantityOnHand - p.QuantityAllocated          AS QuantityAvailable
,       p.LastMovementDate
,       si.UnitCost
,       si.IsChillerStock
,       si.ShelfLifeDays
,       (p.QuantityOnHand * si.UnitCost)                AS OnHandValue
        /* Ageing bands were agreed with the finance team in 2008 and are still
           what the obsolescence provision is calculated from. */
,       CASE
            WHEN p.LastMovementDate IS NULL                              THEN 'NEVER'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, p.LastMovementDate, p.SnapshotDate) > 365 THEN 'D365P'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, p.LastMovementDate, p.SnapshotDate) > 180 THEN 'D180'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, p.LastMovementDate, p.SnapshotDate) > 90  THEN 'D090'
            ELSE 'FRESH'
        END                                             AS AgeBandCode
,       CASE WHEN si.IsChillerStock = 1
                  AND DATEDIFF(DAY, p.ReceiptDate, p.SnapshotDate) > si.ShelfLifeDays
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                          AS IsExpiredChillerStock
FROM    work.InventoryPositionDaily AS p
INNER JOIN stg.StockItem AS si
        ON  si.StockItemId = p.StockItemId
WHERE   p.SnapshotDate = CAST(? AS date)

chain.name: Publish Inventory Health
chain.sql:
MERGE Aggregate.[Daily Inventory Health] AS target
USING (SELECT WarehouseSiteCode, RegionCode,
              COUNT(*) AS SuggestionCount,
              SUM(CASE WHEN IsStockoutRisk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StockoutRiskCount,
              SUM(SuggestedQuantity) AS SuggestedUnits
       FROM   work.ReplenishmentSuggestion
       GROUP BY WarehouseSiteCode, RegionCode) AS source
    ON  target.[Warehouse Site Code] = source.WarehouseSiteCode
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.[Suggestion Count] = source.SuggestionCount,
                             target.[Stockout Risk Count] = source.StockoutRiskCount,
                             target.[Suggested Units] = source.SuggestedUnits
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT ([Warehouse Site Code], [Region Code], [Suggestion Count],
            [Stockout Risk Count], [Suggested Units])
    VALUES (source.WarehouseSiteCode, source.RegionCode, source.SuggestionCount,
            source.StockoutRiskCount, source.SuggestedUnits);

components.name: stg StockMovement Transfers
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  t.StockTransferId
,       t.TransferReference
,       t.StockItemId
,       t.FromWarehouseSiteCode
,       t.ToWarehouseSiteCode
,       t.DespatchedAtUtc
,       t.ReceivedAtUtc
,       t.QuantityDespatched
,       t.QuantityReceived
,       t.QuantityDespatched - ISNULL(t.QuantityReceived, 0) AS QuantityInTransit
,       t.TransferStatusCode
,       t.CarrierCode
,       si.UnitCost
,       fw.RegionCode                                   AS FromRegionCode
,       tw.RegionCode                                   AS ToRegionCode
        /* Cross-region transfers are treated as an intercompany sale in the
           finance mart, so the movement carries the transfer price rather than
           standard cost. */
,       CASE WHEN fw.RegionCode <> tw.RegionCode
             THEN ISNULL(tp.TransferPrice, si.UnitCost * 1.08)
             ELSE si.UnitCost
        END                                             AS MovementUnitValue
FROM    stg.StockMovement AS t
INNER JOIN stg.StockItem AS si ON si.StockItemId = t.StockItemId
INNER JOIN stg.WarehouseSite AS fw ON fw.WarehouseSiteCode = t.FromWarehouseSiteCode
INNER JOIN stg.WarehouseSite AS tw ON tw.WarehouseSiteCode = t.ToWarehouseSiteCode
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.TransferPrice AS tp
        ON  tp.StockItemId = t.StockItemId
        AND tp.FromRegionCode = fw.RegionCode
        AND tp.ToRegionCode = tw.RegionCode
WHERE   t.MovementTypeCode = 'TRANSFER'
AND     t.LoadBatchId = ?

chain.name: Build On Hand Comparison
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO etl.ReconciliationResult
    (BatchId, ReconciliationName, ObjectName, SourceKey, SourceAmount, TargetAmount,
     VarianceAmount, VarianceStatus, EvaluatedAtUtc)
SELECT  ?
,       N'DW on-hand vs operational on-hand'
,       N'Fact.Stock Holding'
,       CONCAT(pos.WarehouseSiteCode, N'|', CAST(pos.StockItemId AS nvarchar(20)))
,       ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0)
,       ISNULL(dw.[Quantity On Hand], 0)
,       ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0) - ISNULL(dw.[Quantity On Hand], 0)
,       CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0) = ISNULL(dw.[Quantity On Hand], 0)
                THEN N'Matched'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg.StockMovement AS m
                         WHERE m.StockItemId = pos.StockItemId
                           AND m.WarehouseSiteCode = pos.WarehouseSiteCode
                           AND m.MovementAtUtc >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -?, SYSUTCDATETIME()))
                THEN N'Timing'
            WHEN ISNULL(pos.QuantityOnHand, 0) < 0 THEN N'Negative on hand'
            ELSE N'Variance'
        END
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM    work.InventoryPositionDaily AS pos
FULL OUTER JOIN Fact.[Stock Holding] AS dw
        ON  dw.[WWI Stock Item ID] = pos.StockItemId
        AND dw.[Warehouse Site Code] = pos.WarehouseSiteCode
WHERE   ? = N'ALL' OR pos.WarehouseSiteCode = ?;

AND VarianceStatus = N'Variance' AND    ObjectName = N'Fact.Stock Holding';

    (VolumeMountPoint, TotalBytes, AvailableBytes, FreePercent, DatabaseName,
     FileTypeCode, CheckedAtUtc)
SELECT DISTINCT
        vs.volume_mount_point
,       vs.total_bytes
,       vs.available_bytes
,       CAST(vs.available_bytes * 100.0 / NULLIF(vs.total_bytes, 0) AS decimal(9, 2))
,       DB_NAME(f.database_id)
,       CASE WHEN f.type = 1 THEN N'LOG' ELSE N'DATA' END
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()

CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(f.database_id, f.file_id) AS vs;

chain.name: Project Batch Growth

INSERT INTO work.VolumeGrowthProjection
    (VolumeMountPoint, ProjectedBytes, BasisDescription, CheckedAtUtc)
SELECT  v.VolumeMountPoint
,       CAST(AVG(CAST(g.BytesWritten AS bigint)) * 1.33 AS bigint)
,       N'Average of the last ten nightly loads plus index maintenance headroom'
,       SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM    work.VolumeSpaceCheck AS v
INNER JOIN etl.LoadVolumeHistory AS g ON g.VolumeMountPoint = v.VolumeMountPoint
WHERE   g.LoadDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS date))
GROUP BY v.VolumeMountPoint;

,       CAST(v.AvailableBytes / 1073741824 AS int) AS AvailableGb

,       CAST(ISNULL(p.ProjectedBytes, 0) / 1073741824 AS int) AS ProjectedGb
FROM    work.VolumeSpaceCheck AS v

,       CAST(v.FreePercent AS int) AS FreePercent

chain.name: Build Purge Plan
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.StagingPurgePlan
    (SchemaName, TableName, LoadDateColumn, RetentionDays, CutoffDate, EstimatedRows)
SELECT  t.SchemaName
,       t.TableName
,       ISNULL(t.LoadDateColumn, N'LoadedAtUtc')
,       CASE
            WHEN t.SchemaName = N'raw' AND t.TableName LIKE N'Fin%'   THEN 2555
            WHEN t.TableName LIKE N'%Partner%'                        THEN 365
            WHEN t.SchemaName = N'work'                               THEN 14
            ELSE ?
        END
,       DATEADD(DAY, -1 * CASE
            WHEN t.SchemaName = N'raw' AND t.TableName LIKE N'Fin%'   THEN 2555
            WHEN t.TableName LIKE N'%Partner%'                        THEN 365
            WHEN t.SchemaName = N'work'                               THEN 14
            ELSE ? END, CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS date))
,       t.ApproximateRowCount
FROM    etl.StagingTableRegister AS t
WHERE   t.IsPurgeEligible = 1;

chain.name: Survey Index Fragmentation
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.IndexMaintenancePlan
    (SchemaName, TableName, IndexName, IndexTypeCode, FragmentationPercent,
     PageCount, PlannedAction)
SELECT  SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id)
,       o.name
,       i.name
,       CASE WHEN i.type IN (5, 6) THEN N'COLUMNSTORE' ELSE N'ROWSTORE' END
,       s.avg_fragmentation_in_percent
,       s.page_count
,       CASE
            WHEN i.type IN (5, 6) THEN N'COLUMNSTORE_REBUILD'
            WHEN s.avg_fragmentation_in_percent >= ? THEN N'REBUILD'
            WHEN s.avg_fragmentation_in_percent >= ? THEN N'REORGANIZE'
            ELSE N'NONE'
        END
FROM    sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, N'LIMITED') AS s
INNER JOIN sys.indexes AS i ON i.object_id = s.object_id AND i.index_id = s.index_id
INNER JOIN sys.objects AS o ON o.object_id = i.object_id
WHERE   o.is_ms_shipped = 0
AND     i.name IS NOT NULL
AND     s.page_count > 1000;

chain.name: Maintain Rowstore Indexes
Measure Index Actions
chain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS PlannedActions,        SUM(CASE WHEN PlannedAction = N'REBUILD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Rebuilt,        SUM(CASE WHEN PlannedAction = N'REORGANIZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Reorganised FROM   work.IndexMaintenancePlan WHERE PlannedAction <> N'NONE';

chain.name: Plan Statistics Refresh
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.StatisticsRefreshPlan
    (SchemaName, TableName, StatisticsName, ModifiedRowCount, RefreshMode)
SELECT  SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id)
,       o.name
,       st.name
,       sp.modification_counter
,       CASE WHEN o.name LIKE N'Dim%' THEN N'FULLSCAN' ELSE N'SAMPLE' END
FROM    sys.stats AS st
INNER JOIN sys.objects AS o ON o.object_id = st.object_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(st.object_id, st.stats_id) AS sp
WHERE   o.is_ms_shipped = 0
AND     sp.modification_counter >= ?;

chain.name: Check Required Keys
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.ConfigurationValidation
    (ConfigurationKey, EnvironmentCode, CheckTypeCode, CheckStatus, DetailText)
SELECT  r.ConfigurationKey
,       ?
,       N'REQUIRED'
,       CASE WHEN c.ConfigurationValue IS NULL THEN N'MISSING'
             WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(c.ConfigurationValue)) = N'' THEN N'EMPTY'
             ELSE N'OK' END
,       CASE WHEN c.ConfigurationValue IS NULL
             THEN N'Key is not defined for this environment' ELSE NULL END
FROM    etl.RequiredConfigurationKey AS r
LEFT OUTER JOIN etl.Configuration AS c
       ON  c.ConfigurationKey = r.ConfigurationKey
       AND c.EnvironmentCode = ?
WHERE   r.IsMandatory = 1;

chain.name: Check Connection Placeholders
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.ConfigurationValidation
    (ConfigurationKey, EnvironmentCode, CheckTypeCode, CheckStatus, DetailText)
SELECT  k.PlaceholderName
,       ?
,       N'PLACEHOLDER'
,       CASE WHEN c.ConfigurationValue IS NULL THEN N'MISSING' ELSE N'OK' END
,       N'Connection placeholder resolved from the environment, never stored inline'
FROM    (VALUES (N'ORACLE_HOST'), (N'ORACLE_PORT'), (N'ORACLE_SERVICE'),
                (N'ORACLE_USER'), (N'SQLSERVER_HOST'), (N'SQLSERVER_PORT'),
                (N'SQLSERVER_USER'), (N'SQLSERVER_OLTP_DB'),
                (N'SQLSERVER_STAGING_DB'), (N'SQLSERVER_DW_DB'))
            AS k(PlaceholderName)
LEFT OUTER JOIN etl.Configuration AS c
       ON  c.ConfigurationKey = k.PlaceholderName
       AND c.EnvironmentCode = ?;

chain.name: Check Value Plausibility
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.ConfigurationValidation
    (ConfigurationKey, EnvironmentCode, CheckTypeCode, CheckStatus, DetailText)
SELECT  N'OPEN_PERIOD_' + p.RegionCode
,       ?
,       N'PLAUSIBILITY'
,       CASE WHEN p.OpenPeriodKey IS NULL THEN N'MISSING'
             WHEN p.RegionCode = N'APAC' AND p.FiscalCalendarCode <> N'445'
                  THEN N'SUSPECT'
             WHEN p.RegionCode = N'EU' AND p.VatRegimeCode IS NULL THEN N'SUSPECT'
             WHEN p.OpenPeriodKey < CONVERT(int, FORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH, -2,
                  SYSUTCDATETIME()), N'yyyyMM')) THEN N'SUSPECT'
             ELSE N'OK' END
,       CONCAT(N'Region ', p.RegionCode, N' open period ',
                CAST(ISNULL(p.OpenPeriodKey, 0) AS nvarchar(10)))
FROM    etl.RegionPeriodStatus AS p
UNION ALL
SELECT  N'FX_RATES_' + r.RegionCode, ?, N'PLAUSIBILITY'
,       CASE WHEN r.RateCount = 0 THEN N'MISSING' ELSE N'OK' END
,       CONCAT(N'FX rates loaded for the business date: ',
                CAST(r.RateCount AS nvarchar(10)))
FROM    (SELECT RegionCode, COUNT(*) AS RateCount
         FROM   etl.FxRateAvailability
         WHERE  RateDate = CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS date)
         GROUP BY RegionCode) AS r;

chain.name: Evaluate Contract Compliance
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.ContractCompliance
    (PurchaseOrderNumber, LineNumber, SupplierId, CategoryCode, OrderDate, OrderedAmount,
     ContractNumber, ContractPricePerOuter, ComplianceStatusCode, LeakageAmount)
SELECT  pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
,       pol.LineNumber
,       poh.SupplierId
,       pol.CategoryCode
,       poh.OrderDate
,       pol.OrderedOuters * pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter
,       vc.ContractNumber
,       vc.ContractPricePerOuter
,       CASE
            WHEN vc.ContractNumber IS NULL
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg.VendorContract AS alt
                             WHERE alt.CategoryCode = pol.CategoryCode
                               AND alt.IsPreferred = 1
                               AND poh.OrderDate BETWEEN alt.ContractStartDate
                                   AND ISNULL(alt.ContractEndDate, '9999-12-31'))
                THEN N'NON_PREFERRED'
            WHEN vc.ContractNumber IS NULL THEN N'NO_CONTRACT'
            WHEN poh.OrderDate > ISNULL(vc.ContractEndDate, '9999-12-31')
                THEN N'EXPIRED_CONTRACT'
            WHEN pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter >
                 vc.ContractPricePerOuter * (1 + (? / 100.0))
                THEN N'PRICE_LEAKAGE'
            ELSE N'COMPLIANT'
        END
,       CASE WHEN vc.ContractPricePerOuter IS NULL THEN 0
             ELSE CASE WHEN pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter > vc.ContractPricePerOuter
                       THEN (pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter - vc.ContractPricePerOuter)
                            * pol.OrderedOuters
                       ELSE 0 END
        END
FROM    stg.PurchaseOrderLine AS pol
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderHeader AS poh
        ON  poh.PurchaseOrderNumber = pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.VendorContract AS vc
        ON  vc.SupplierId = poh.SupplierId
        AND vc.CategoryCode = pol.CategoryCode
WHERE   poh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -?, CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS date));

chain.name: Measure Leakage
chain.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(LeakageAmount), 0) AS Leakage,        SUM(CASE WHEN ComplianceStatusCode = N'EXPIRED_CONTRACT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)            AS ExpiredContracts FROM work.ContractCompliance;

chain.name: Publish Compliance To Scorecard
chain.sql:
UPDATE sp
SET    sp.[Off Contract Spend Amount] = c.OffContractAmount
,      sp.[Leakage Amount] = c.LeakageAmount
,      sp.[Compliance Percent] = CASE WHEN c.TotalAmount = 0 THEN 100
            ELSE (c.TotalAmount - c.OffContractAmount) * 100 / c.TotalAmount END
FROM   Aggregate.[Supplier Performance] AS sp
INNER JOIN (SELECT SupplierId,
                   SUM(OrderedAmount) AS TotalAmount,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN ComplianceStatusCode <> N'COMPLIANT'
                            THEN OrderedAmount ELSE 0 END) AS OffContractAmount,
                   SUM(LeakageAmount) AS LeakageAmount
            FROM   work.ContractCompliance
            GROUP BY SupplierId) AS c
        ON c.SupplierId = sp.[WWI Supplier ID];

chain.name: Raise Non Compliant Lines
chain.sql: INSERT INTO etl.RejectedRecord     (BatchId, ObjectName, RejectStage, RejectReasonCode, RejectReason,      BusinessKey, LoggedAtUtc, IsReprocessed) SELECT ?, N'stg.VendorContract', N'Fact', ComplianceStatusCode,        N'Purchase line failed contract compliance',        CONCAT(PurchaseOrderNumber, N'|', CAST(LineNumber AS nvarchar(10))),        SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 FROM   work.ContractCompliance WHERE ComplianceStatusCode <> N'COMPLIANT';

components.name: stg PurchaseOrderLine
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  pol.PurchaseOrderLineId
,       pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
,       pol.LineNumber
,       poh.SupplierId
,       poh.OrderDate
,       poh.BuyerPersonId
,       poh.RegionCode
,       poh.CurrencyCode
,       pol.StockItemId
,       pol.OrderedOuters
,       pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter
,       pol.OrderedOuters * pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter       AS OrderedAmount
,       pol.ReceivedOuters
,       pol.IsOrderLineFinalized
,       pol.CategoryCode
,       vc.ContractNumber
,       vc.ContractPricePerOuter
,       vc.ContractStartDate
,       vc.ContractEndDate
        /* The ERP contract key changed format in 2013 but the old numbers were
           never migrated, so both shapes have to be matched. */
,       CASE
            WHEN vc.ContractNumber IS NOT NULL              THEN vc.ContractNumber
            WHEN pol.LegacyContractRef LIKE 'C-%'           THEN pol.LegacyContractRef
            WHEN pol.LegacyContractRef LIKE '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                THEN 'C-' + pol.LegacyContractRef
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                     AS ResolvedContractNumber
FROM    stg.PurchaseOrderLine AS pol
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderHeader AS poh
        ON  poh.PurchaseOrderNumber = pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.VendorContract AS vc
        ON  vc.SupplierId = poh.SupplierId
        AND vc.CategoryCode = pol.CategoryCode
        AND poh.OrderDate BETWEEN vc.ContractStartDate AND ISNULL(vc.ContractEndDate, '9999-12-31')
WHERE   pol.LoadBatchId = ?
AND     poh.OrderStatusCode NOT IN ('CANC', 'DRAFT')

SELECT  r.ReceiptId
,       r.ReceiptNumber
,       r.PurchaseOrderNumber
,       r.LineNumber
,       r.ReceivedAtUtc
,       r.ReceivedOuters
,       r.WarehouseSiteCode
,       pol.OrderedOuters

FROM    stg.Receipt AS r
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderLine AS pol
        ON  pol.PurchaseOrderNumber = r.PurchaseOrderNumber
        AND pol.LineNumber = r.LineNumber
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderHeader AS poh
        ON  poh.PurchaseOrderNumber = r.PurchaseOrderNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.ApInvoiceLine AS ail
        ON  ail.PurchaseOrderNumber = r.PurchaseOrderNumber
        AND ail.PurchaseOrderLineNumber = r.LineNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.MatchTolerance AS tol
        ON  tol.RegionCode = poh.RegionCode
        AND tol.CategoryCode = pol.CategoryCode
WHERE   r.LoadBatchId = ?

chain.name: Build Scorecard Measures
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.SupplierScorecard
    (SupplierId, RegionCode, OrderCount, OnTimeCount, QuantityAccurateCount,
     PriceAdherentCount, QualityRejectCount, InvoiceExceptionCount, WindowDays)
SELECT  s.SupplierId
,       s.RegionCode
,       COUNT(DISTINCT r.PurchaseOrderNumber)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN r.ReceivedAtUtc <= pol.PromisedDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN r.ReceivedOuters = pol.OrderedOuters THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(ail.InvoicedUnitPrice, pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter)
                          - pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter) < 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN r.QualityStatusCode = N'REJECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
,       SUM(CASE WHEN ail.ApInvoiceNumber IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
,       ?
FROM    stg.Supplier AS s
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderHeader AS poh ON poh.SupplierId = s.SupplierId
INNER JOIN stg.PurchaseOrderLine AS pol
        ON  pol.PurchaseOrderNumber = poh.PurchaseOrderNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.Receipt AS r
        ON  r.PurchaseOrderNumber = pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
        AND r.LineNumber = pol.LineNumber
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.ApInvoiceLine AS ail
        ON  ail.PurchaseOrderNumber = pol.PurchaseOrderNumber
        AND ail.PurchaseOrderLineNumber = pol.LineNumber
WHERE   poh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -?, CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS date))
GROUP BY s.SupplierId, s.RegionCode;

WITH DateSpine AS
(
    SELECT CONVERT(date, N'2005-01-01') AS CalendarDate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATEADD(day, 1, CalendarDate) FROM DateSpine
    WHERE CalendarDate < CONVERT(date, N'2035-12-31')
)
SELECT s.CalendarDate, YEAR(s.CalendarDate) AS CalendarYear,
       MONTH(s.CalendarDate) AS CalendarMonth, DAY(s.CalendarDate) AS CalendarDay,
       DATEPART(weekday, s.CalendarDate) AS DayOfWeekNumber,
       DATENAME(month, s.CalendarDate) AS MonthName,
       DATENAME(weekday, s.CalendarDate) AS DayName,
       (SELECT FiscalYearStartMonth FROM ref.Region WHERE RegionCode = N'NA')
           AS FiscalYearStartMonthNa,
       (SELECT FiscalYearStartMonth FROM ref.Region WHERE RegionCode = N'EU')
           AS FiscalYearStartMonthEu,
       (SELECT FiscalYearStartMonth FROM ref.Region WHERE RegionCode = N'APAC')
           AS FiscalYearStartMonthApac
FROM DateSpine AS s
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

SELECT  sl.SaleLineId
,       sl.InvoiceNumber

        AND sl.InvoiceDate BETWEEN cp.EffectiveFrom AND ISNULL(cp.EffectiveTo, '9999-12-31')
INNER JOIN stg.FiscalCalendar445 AS d
        ON  d.CalendarDate = CAST(sl.InvoiceDate AS date)
WHERE   sl.RegionCode = 'APAC'

components.name: stg SaleLine EU
components.sql_or_table:
SELECT  sl.SaleLineId
,       sl.InvoiceNumber
,       sl.InvoiceDate
,       sl.SalespersonPersonId
,       sl.CustomerId
,       sl.CountryCode
,       sl.TerritoryCode
,       sl.CurrencyCode
,       sl.ExtendedPrice
,       sl.VatAmount
,       sl.VatRatePercent
        /* EU pays on the VAT-exclusive net amount. Where the source system has
           already stored a net amount we trust it, otherwise we back the VAT
           out of the gross using the line's own rate. */
,       CASE
            WHEN sl.NetAmount IS NOT NULL THEN sl.NetAmount
            WHEN ISNULL(sl.VatRatePercent, 0) > 0
                THEN sl.ExtendedPrice / (1 + (sl.VatRatePercent / 100))
            ELSE sl.ExtendedPrice - ISNULL(sl.VatAmount, 0)
        END                                             AS NetCommissionableAmount
,       cp.PlanCode
,       cp.BaseRatePercent
,       cp.StatutoryCapAmount
,       CONVERT(char(7), sl.InvoiceDate, 126)           AS CommissionPeriod
,       fx.ConversionRate                               AS EurConversionRate
FROM    stg.SaleLine AS sl
INNER JOIN stg.CommissionPlan AS cp
        ON  cp.SalespersonPersonId = sl.SalespersonPersonId
        AND cp.RegionCode = 'EU'
        AND sl.InvoiceDate BETWEEN cp.EffectiveFrom AND ISNULL(cp.EffectiveTo, '9999-12-31')
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.FxRate AS fx
        ON  fx.CurrencyCode = sl.CurrencyCode
        AND fx.QuoteCurrencyCode = 'EUR'
        AND fx.RateTypeCode = 'AVERAGE'
        AND fx.RateDate = EOMONTH(sl.InvoiceDate)
WHERE   sl.RegionCode = 'EU'
AND     sl.LoadBatchId = ?
AND     sl.LineTypeCode NOT IN ('SAMPLE', 'INTERNAL')

chain.name: Calculate EU Commission
chain.sql:
SELECT  sl.SaleLineId
,       sl.InvoiceNumber
,       sl.InvoiceDate
,       sl.SalespersonPersonId
,       sl.CustomerId
,       sl.CountryCode
,       sl.TerritoryCode
,       sl.CurrencyCode
,       sl.ExtendedPrice
,       sl.VatAmount
,       sl.VatRatePercent
        /* EU pays on the VAT-exclusive net amount. Where the source system has
           already stored a net amount we trust it, otherwise we back the VAT
           out of the gross using the line's own rate. */
,       CASE
            WHEN sl.NetAmount IS NOT NULL THEN sl.NetAmount
            WHEN ISNULL(sl.VatRatePercent, 0) > 0
                THEN sl.ExtendedPrice / (1 + (sl.VatRatePercent / 100))
            ELSE sl.ExtendedPrice - ISNULL(sl.VatAmount, 0)
        END                                             AS NetCommissionableAmount
,       cp.PlanCode
,       cp.BaseRatePercent
,       cp.StatutoryCapAmount
,       CONVERT(char(7), sl.InvoiceDate, 126)           AS CommissionPeriod
,       fx.ConversionRate                               AS EurConversionRate
FROM    stg.SaleLine AS sl
INNER JOIN stg.CommissionPlan AS cp
        ON  cp.SalespersonPersonId = sl.SalespersonPersonId

chain.name: Build Partner Feed Rows
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.PartnerFeedRow
    (PartnerCode, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, CustomerReference, StockItemCode,
     Quantity, NetAmount, SettlementCurrencyCode, RegionCode)
SELECT  pa.[Partner Code]
,       s.[WWI Invoice ID]
,       s.[Invoice Date Key]
,       CASE WHEN c.[Region Code] = N'EU' AND ISNULL(c.[Share Consent Flag], 0) = 0
             THEN N'REDACTED' ELSE c.[Customer Reference] END
,       si.[Stock Item Code]
,       s.Quantity
,       s.[Total Excluding Tax] * ISNULL(fx.ConversionRate, 1)
,       pa.[Settlement Currency Code]
,       c.[Region Code]
FROM    Fact.Sale AS s
INNER JOIN Dimension.Customer AS c ON c.[Customer Key] = s.[Customer Key]
INNER JOIN Dimension.[Stock Item] AS si ON si.[Stock Item Key] = s.[Stock Item Key]
INNER JOIN Dimension.Partner AS pa ON pa.[Partner Key] = c.[Partner Key]
LEFT OUTER JOIN work.FxRevaluationRate AS fx
        ON  fx.CurrencyCode = s.[Currency Code]
        AND fx.QuoteCurrencyCode = pa.[Settlement Currency Code]
        AND fx.RateTypeCode = N'AVERAGE'
WHERE   (? = N'ALL' OR pa.[Partner Code] = ?)
AND     s.[Invoice Date Key] >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS date));

SELECT  p.PromotionId
,       p.PromotionCode
,       p.PromotionName
,       p.RegionCode
,       p.StartDate
,       p.EndDate

,       p.DiscountValue
,       p.BudgetAmount
,       r.SaleLineId
,       r.InvoiceDate
,       r.CustomerId
,       r.StockItemId
,       r.RedeemedAmount
,       r.RedemptionChannelCode
        /* Attribution window differs by region: NA gives credit for 30 days
           after the promotion ends, EU only within the promotion window
           because of consumer-protection rules, APAC for 14 days. */
,       CASE p.RegionCode
            WHEN 'NA'   THEN DATEADD(DAY, 30, p.EndDate)
            WHEN 'APAC' THEN DATEADD(DAY, 14, p.EndDate)
            ELSE p.EndDate
        END                                             AS AttributionEndDate

        ON  r.PromotionId = p.PromotionId

chain.name: Build Attainment By Region
chain.sql:
INSERT INTO work.QuotaAttainment
    (TerritoryCode, RegionCode, QuotaPeriod, QuotaAmount, ActualAmount, MeasureBasisCode)
SELECT  t.TerritoryCode, N'NA', q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount,
        ISNULL(SUM(sl.ExtendedPrice + sl.TaxAmount), 0), N'INVOICED'
FROM    stg.SalesTerritory AS t
INNER JOIN stg.SalesQuota AS q ON q.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode AND q.QuotaPeriod = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.SaleLine AS sl
        ON  sl.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode AND sl.RegionCode = N'NA'
        AND CONVERT(char(7), sl.InvoiceDate, 126) = q.QuotaPeriod
WHERE   t.RegionCode = N'NA'
GROUP BY t.TerritoryCode, q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount
UNION ALL
SELECT  t.TerritoryCode, N'EU', q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount,
        ISNULL(SUM(sl.NetAmount), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(cn.CreditAmount), 0), N'NET_OF_CREDITS'
FROM    stg.SalesTerritory AS t
INNER JOIN stg.SalesQuota AS q ON q.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode AND q.QuotaPeriod = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.SaleLine AS sl
        ON  sl.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode AND sl.RegionCode = N'EU'
        AND CONVERT(char(7), sl.InvoiceDate, 126) = q.QuotaPeriod
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.CreditNote AS cn
        ON  cn.InvoiceNumber = sl.InvoiceNumber
WHERE   t.RegionCode = N'EU'
GROUP BY t.TerritoryCode, q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount
UNION ALL
SELECT  t.TerritoryCode, N'APAC', q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount,
        ISNULL(SUM(ol.OrderLineAmount), 0), N'ORDER_INTAKE'
FROM    stg.SalesTerritory AS t
INNER JOIN stg.SalesQuota AS q ON q.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode AND q.QuotaPeriod = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.OrderLine AS ol
        ON  ol.TerritoryCode = t.TerritoryCode
LEFT OUTER JOIN stg.FiscalCalendar445 AS f
        ON  f.CalendarDate = CAST(ol.OrderDate AS date)
        AND f.FiscalPeriod445 = q.QuotaPeriod
WHERE   t.RegionCode = N'APAC'
GROUP BY t.TerritoryCode, q.QuotaPeriod, q.QuotaAmount;
